_comment: Download budget for the game shell (#624): everything a first visit to the game fetches, docs and API excluded. Raise only by a deliberate commit that says why.
_why: 2026-10-15, v2.2.0: 512/160 -> 640/200 KB. The campaign (#566-#570), the string layer with en and pt-BR (#622, ~36 KB gzipped together), the tuning bench (#638), the X-ray (#637) and the ns-3 export (#640) put the shell at 557 KB raw / 188 KB gzipped, with both language files precached so the game also plays offline in Portuguese. The WASM core is unchanged. 2026-10-17, v2.3.0: 640/200 -> 680/220 KB. Chapters 3-5 of the campaign (#576-#578) and their adapter features (#575: routes, attenuation zones, batteries, ground stations, the city/forest/orbit worlds) put the shell at 622 KB raw / 208 KB gzipped: 13 levels' text in en and pt-BR (~6 KB gzipped of the growth), the new device sprites in iso.js, and the scenario code in the WASM adapter. The core routing code is unchanged. 2026-10-21, v2.4.0: 680/220 -> 740/240 KB. Main stood at 651 KB raw / 219 KB gzipped. The chapter 6-8 adapter features (#582: jamming zones, scripted events, the Mixed ground/air/space channel and the disaster/valley/sagin worlds) add about 10 KB raw / 3 KB gzipped of WASM, and chapters 6-8 (#583-#585) bring 9 levels' text in en and pt-BR plus the jam-zone and mixed-world drawing in iso.js: about 12-15 KB gzipped more, measured per chapter in their PRs. The core routing code is unchanged.
